accepted_decisions.operative_body: That Council proceed with consideration of Bylaw 1991 to amend the text of the CD2 Zone by adding pet daycare as a permitted use on the property located at #136-1047 Langford Parkway.

That Development Variance Permit No. DVP21-0001 be issued by the Council for the City of Langford to Rachael Sansom of Grayland Consulting Ltd. on behalf of Tekloch Homes Ltd. to allow a two-point turn in lieu of a cul-de-sac for the proposed townhouse site at 3296 Jacklin Road subject to the following terms and conditions: 1. Appendix The site shall be developed in accordance with the site plan attached to the report to Planning, Zoning and Affordable Housing dated 14th June 2021 (Appendix A). 2. Variances The following regulations of Zoning Bylaw No. 300 are varied under Section 498 of the Local Government Act: a) That Schedule 4 of Subdivision and Development Servicing Bylaw No. 1000 be varied to allow for a permanent two-point turnaround in lieu of a cul-de-sac.

accepted_decisions.operative_body: That Council: 1. Approve the Encroachment Agreement substantially in the form attached, subject to minor amendments that do not affect the substantive terms of the agreement and authorize the Mayor and CAO to execute the Encroachment Agreement; and 2. Direct staff to prepare a policy with regard to encroachment agreements onto City owned property.
That Council approve the change of funding source, to a capital reserve account, for the repair of the southern boardwalk at the Ed Nixon Trail.

That Council support the Station Avenue Revitalization Project, instruct staff to proceed with the Canada Community Revitalization Fund grant application, and approve the funding of the City's portion of the second phase of the project from capital reserves.
That Council adopt Bylaw No. 1844.
That Council give Bylaw No. 1856 first reading.
That Council give Bylaw No. 1896 first reading.
That Council give Bylaw No. 1897 first reading.
That Council give Bylaw No. 1919 second and third readings.
That Council adopt Bylaw No. 1957.
That Council rescind first reading of Bylaw No. 1962 and give it new first reading.
That Council give Bylaw No. 1982 second and third readings.
That Council adopt Bylaw No. 1987.

That Council give Bylaw No. 1994 first reading.
That Council adopt Bylaw No. 1965.

That Council adopt Bylaw No. 1967.
That Council give Bylaw No. 1969 second and third readings.
